items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I had to make a record for Mr. Paul Winters from Greenpoint, Connecticut.

ctx.x: Kailer, and the Godfather went up in some malls for Peter's wife, you see. And we went up into Westchester in different places like that; in Connecticut like that.

And it was during -- I had to make some recordings. I had to make a record for Mr. Paul Winters from Greenpoint, Connecticut. I made "Mr. Bojangles" with Peter, Paul, and Mary Ford. And I had to make another one "On the Amazon" here in Manhattan for Mr. Ed Freeman and his partner, you know. Wherever I was, I mean I had to do the followups.
